versions.name: Swimming
versions.description: Swim front crawl, back crawl, sidestroke, breaststroke and elementary backstroke over a continuous distance, surface dive for an object, float to survive cold water, and rescue someone by reaching or throwing.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
